correctness.rationale: Complete analytic 6-generator determinant proof yields V=16(1+L). Exact 512-sign-matrix argument counts the 96 distinct SO(3) maxima. At every maximum the Hessian of the volume deficit in rotation-vector coordinates is diagonal (48,48,64), i.e. deficit quadratic form (24,24,32), so a normalized Haar ellipsoid sum gives 1/(6 sqrt(2) pi). A bounded-tail Laplace argument gives the precise real-k high-moment constant. Finite exact-rational enumeration and independent 20-minor float checks were replayed from the packaged verifier; they supplement, do not replace, the universal proof.

value.rationale: Quantifies the exact rarity, with leading constant rather than only exponent, of cube-pair rotations whose Minkowski exclusion volume nearly attains its maximum. The same calculation gives the sharp high-moment prefactor for the very O(3) l1-norm asymptotic program highlighted by a 2009 source. The natural full Haar orientation law and geometric endpoint, not an arbitrary subset of parameters, motivate the exact statistic.
